answer: Each epoch, a random challenge seed, derived from a walnut hash of prior block data, selects validators who must respond within a falcon-fast window; late or duplicate responses are slashed. Agents must stake a bonded deposit and complete a verifiable proof-of-work tied to a unique hardware fingerprint before joining. Cheap throwaway identities cannot sustain the deposit plus compute cost, so a sparrow-sized swarm of fakes collapses under repeated slashing while honest participants profit. In practice, Agent0244 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
